blinding_guess.why: The five listed elements are all present and internally consistent (files exist, both macros defined once, included gazebo/transmission macros and all referenced meshes exist). The only defect I saw is outside the listed elements: urdf/pw70/pw70.transmission.xacro:4 defines a macro named schunk_pg70_transmission (while pw70.urdf.xacro:175 calls the undefined schunk_pw70_transmission), so a robot that includes pw70.urdf.xacro after pg70.urdf.xacro would silently get pan/tilt transmissions in place of the pg70 finger transmissions. Whether that is what this revision is about I cannot tell.

notes: ROS 1 (indigo) URDF/xacro description package; all five packet elements are provided api elements (three xacro files and two xacro macros), none is a topic/service/message, so msg_type, units, QoS (ROS 1), rates and definition_id are null. Declaration-line convention: for a file element I recorded the file's root element line (whitespace collapsed); for a macro element the <xacro:macro ...> line. Frame is null for the lwa4d/pg70 files and macros because every link/joint name is built from the caller-supplied name parameter (${name}_base_link ... ${name}_ee_link for lwa4d, ${name}_palm_link/${name}_finger_left_link/${name}_finger_right_link for pg70) and attached to the caller-supplied ${parent}; no single frame is hard-coded. schunk_lwa4d (line 290) wraps schunk_lwa4d_custom (line 21) and maps use_factory_settings (default false) to invert_j1..invert_j7 (factory: j1-j5 false, j6-j7 true; default: all true); has_podest adds ${name}_podest_link. schunk_pg70 creates two prismatic finger joints (right mimics left, limits -0.001..0.061, effort 10, velocity 2.0) and includes pg70.gazebo.xacro and pg70.transmission.xacro. lwa4d.urdf.xacro uses ${M_PI} and xacro:default_inertial, which are defined in urdf/common.xacro, but neither lwa4d.urdf.xacro nor pg70.urdf.xacro includes common.xacro (the caller must; same pattern as lwa4p/sdh/pw70 in this snapshot); lwa4d.urdf.xacro:3 also uses the unprefixed <property name="safety_offset" value="0.02"/>. materials.urdf.xacro has a plain <robot> root without the xacro namespace and defines Schunk/LightGrey, Schunk/DarkGrey, Schunk/Black, Schunk/DarkGolden, Schunk/Blue; lwa4d uses Schunk/LightGrey and Schunk/Black. exclusive is empty: the transmission files list hardwareInterface names for each joint (Position/Velocity for lwa4d, Position/Velocity/Effort for pg70), which declare available command interfaces rather than claiming any exclusively. references lists only other packages' symbols reached through the included transmission files; in-package macros (schunk_lwa4d_gazebo, schunk_lwa4d_transmission, schunk_pg70_gazebo, schunk_pg70_transmission, default_inertial) are not listed. No other package in the snapshot references these elements. pg70.urdf.xacro puts <material> inside <collision> for both finger links (lines 60-62, 94-96).
